title: 等腰直角三角形装入正方形

knownBest.source: Diameter bound submitted by 😰 #106: two points of a contained shape cannot be farther apart than the square diagonal. Existing constructions attain equality exactly; Friedman provenance and site history remain. No new construction is claimed.
